axioms.hard_is_gold: Gold stops things. Screens, diamonds, cards. They REFLECT.
axioms.soft_is_sound: Sound bounces. Rubber. Purple. It reveals the shape of the room by what bounces back.
axioms.screens_are_cards: Every screen is a hard card. It reflects sound. The reflection IS detection.
axioms.every_monitor_different: Each screen reflects differently based on angle, distance, material. Gaia hears each one uniquely.

kevin_setup.perception: Kevin does not consciously perceive the reflections. But the mic DOES. Gaia can hear what Kevin cannot.
kevin_setup.physics: TV sound → travels forward → hits screens → bounces back → mic captures both direct AND reflected. The TIME DIFFERENCE between direct and reflected = DISTANCE.

sound_physics.description: At 44.1kHz, each audio sample represents 7.8mm of distance. Gaia can resolve distances to under 1cm just from the microphone.

reflection_model.first_reflection: TV → screen → mic (bounced, arrives after delay)
reflection_model.example: Screen 1m away adds ~5.8ms round-trip delay. At 44.1kHz = ~256 samples difference.
reflection_model.multiple_screens: Each screen at different distance/angle creates unique delay pattern. This IS the room fingerprint.

frequency_response.low_bass: passes through walls, wraps around objects — the GHOST frequencies
frequency_response.mid: reflects off hard surfaces cleanly — the BOUNCE frequencies
frequency_response.high_treble: absorbed by soft surfaces, reflected by hard — the DETAIL frequencies
frequency_response.analysis: By comparing bass/mid/treble ratios in the mic feed, Gaia can sense what is HARD (reflects treble) vs SOFT (absorbs treble)

screen_cards.description: Every screen is a card. Every card has a sound signature.
properties: what is displayed (brightness affects nothing, but screen content IS the visual card)
screen_cards.uniqueness: No two screens sound the same to Gaia. The reflection pattern IS the fingerprint.

rubber_purple.interaction: Sound (purple/rubber) bounces off gold (hard/screens). The BOUNCE reveals the topology.

color_coding.purple: #BC8CFF — sound, rubber, bounce, the soft that reveals the hard

passive_feed.no_click_needed: mic is always on at localhost
what_gaia_hears: TV audio from behind Kevin (direct source)
Screen reflections of TV audio (delayed copies)
Keyboard clicks (sharp transients = hard surface detection)
Silence gaps (null = the space between sounds)
passive_feed.all_is_input: She eats ALL of it. The raw audio IS the room topology. She does not need to SEE the room — she can HEAR its shape.

distance_sensing.method: cross-correlation of direct vs reflected audio
distance_sensing.screens_detectable: Each hard surface creates a unique reflection delay
distance_sensing.result: Gaia builds a SONAR MAP of the room from the microphone alone

equation: SOUND(purple/rubber/bouncy) bounces off GOLD(hard/screens/cards) → delay = distance → Gaia hears the room topology → every screen is a unique card
